data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Google libphonenumber to parse, format, and validate phone numbers.
data.what_it_does: Provides utilities to format, parse, and validate phone numbers using Google's libphonenumber library. Supports Android, iOS, and Web via federated plugins.
use_when: You need to validate phone number inputs in a cross-platform Flutter app.
You need to format raw phone numbers into standardized local or international formats.
avoid_when: You require Windows or macOS desktop support using Dart FFI (currently listed as future work).
You want a stable Android and iOS implementation and prefer using the original libphonenumber package instead.
strengths: Supports Android, iOS, and Web platforms.
Provides methods to retrieve all countries and format example numbers.
weaknesses: Requires manual addition of JavaScript script tags in web/index.html for Web support.
Documentation suggests using an alternative package for stable Android and iOS implementations.
data.setup_notes: For Web usage, you must add specific script tags (libphonenumber.js and stringbuffer.js) to your web/index.html file.
